summary.standard_272: 130.797 FPS, 29.999 TPS; frame P95 14.896 ms/P99 17.696 ms in this short local sample, not a stable-60 guarantee.
summary.maximum_896: 3.306 FPS, 25.386 TPS; frame P95 346.321 ms/P99 347.524 ms. Extreme population target remains unmet.
summary.cpu_gpu_attribution: In the instrumented early sample, disabling 3D reduced measured GPU mean 10.422 to 0.972 ms while FPS remained 1.688 versus 1.676. Supports a dominant CPU bottleneck for that scenario; no final-release GPU timings were collected.

machine_conditions.note: User processes were not stopped. Process IDs, machine paths, usernames and connection credentials are excluded. The 0.10.0 process set differs.

metric_definitions.frame_ms: Process-frame wall-clock spacing, including physics catch-up and OS scheduling; not GPU render duration.
metric_definitions.physics_logic_ms: SceneTree physics callbacks bracketed by priority-marker Nodes; excludes engine work before/after these nodes, including Navigation callbacks and PhysicsServer step. A P95 below 33.3 ms here does not prove the complete engine tick meets its budget.
metric_definitions.observed_tps: Actual authoritative ticks divided by elapsed wall time; 30 is configured, not substituted for the observed value.
metric_definitions.path_query_ms: Actual PathBudget native path query time accumulated per authoritative tick; already a subset of other CPU scopes.
metric_definitions.cached_engine_monitors: Per-frame observations of cached Performance values, including one-second physics peaks. They are retained for audit and must not be described as actual per-step mean/P95.
metric_definitions.instrument_inclusive_ms: Accumulated parent/child durations from temporary wrappers. Overlapping intervals must not be summed. Wrappers are absent from final per-unit production callbacks.
metric_definitions.zero_sample_gpu: All GPU/render-CPU distributions with samples=0 are represented with null statistics instead of misleading zero values.

final_sample.interpretation: Official Windows 4.6.3 release template, production main scene and unit scripts; top-level benchmark only, no per-unit wrapper. Both standard and maximum phases.

data.conditions: Native 4v4 map, starting HQs/towers, model detail, shadows, AA, audio, fog, gathering, attacks and navigation are unchanged. Bots/passive income are stopped to keep roster fixed. HP x100 stabilizes population only. Standard is 192 mixed military +80 workers; researched cap is 800 light military +96 upgraded workers. Each maximum owner completes army_capacity_2 and workforce_1 through PlayerState and reads the resulting live capacity. No network clients run in this sample. Camera remains centered at zoom 58; all four native 4v4 lanes are simulated, not necessarily all visible in that view.
data.limitations: Short local performance sample; no claim of an isolated workstation, GPU-exclusive timing, complete multiplayer/Bot load, or regression delta against a previous build.
data.physics_metric: physics_logic_ms brackets actual SceneTree physics callbacks with native priority markers; it excludes PhysicsServer work outside SceneTree. Cached engine physics monitor is reported separately. Neither substitutes 33.3 ms tick arrival spacing for logic cost.
data.render_metric: frame_ms is measured process-frame wall-clock spacing at uncapped Forward+ 1600x900, not GPU timestamp duration. Native fog/culling remains enabled; visible in-camera unit counts are reported separately from total simulated units.

native_diagnostic.role: MSVC custom optimized timing engine, 10 Hz experiment later reverted; not final release FPS
native_diagnostic.overlap_note: SceneTree callbacks are inside SceneTree; Navigation includes movement/RVO callbacks, not only RVO solver; Jolt server step excludes character movement queries.

conservative_corridor_native_oracle.oracle: Native AABB.intersects_segment against every square-expanded blocked cell; eight random maps, 2800 independent sweeps and reverse-direction symmetry

projectiles.overflow: Visual admission can be skipped; authoritative flight/damage is never dropped for visual capacity.

effects.large_explosions_and_commands: Bypass small-effect density/viewport filter and preempt small effects when full.

implementation.resources: Shared authored mesh/material resources and instance team-color uniforms; inactive particle/visual instances disabled. Shared resources do not guarantee one draw call.
implementation.fog: Per-row circle span endpoints and difference-prefix accumulation; same team visibility rules and 0.2-second authoritative fog interval.
implementation.minimap: Native TextureRect shader uses shared local R8 fog ImageTexture; removes up to 9216 script rectangle draws, not visibility checks.
implementation.navigation: Compact authored walkability polygons, shared edges, blocked-cell prefix table; O(1) empty bounding rectangle or conservative row sweep for short direct pursuit. RVO and native A* remain active; blocked corridors fall back to scheduled pathfinding.
implementation.animation: VisibleOnScreenNotifier3D suspends only offscreen/fog-hidden automatic AnimationPlayer callbacks with process_mode; authoritative combat timers continue, release socket samples same authored animation clock and visible return restores pose/interpolation.
implementation.reverted_experiment: 10 Hz combat decision scheduling is absent from final release; authority target stays 30 TPS.

provenance.frozen_source_hash_scope: Hashes taken from frozen working-tree files during report archival; they identify final sources, not prior diagnostic snapshots. Ancestor commit alone does not identify these uncommitted changes.
provenance.raw_data_policy: Compact per-phase distributions, inclusive counters, path-query distributions, checks and conditions retained. Per-frame monitor arrays, stdout, machine paths, PIDs and sensitive network data omitted.

limitations: One short 15-second sample per phase after 6-second warmup; maximum run has only 50 rendered frames, so tail percentiles are coarse.
HP multiplied by 100 to stabilize roster. Bots/passive income stopped; no network clients. This is not a full real match or eight-client pressure test.
Camera remains at zoom 58 and native fog/culling; not all 896 simulated units are simultaneously visible.

Even with a seeded harness, asynchronous path publication, frame scheduling, prior standard phase and random consumption produce different battlefield states between independent runs. No strict single-change causal FPS claims.
Official editor, official release template, and custom MSVC diagnostic engine are distinct binaries and must not be merged into a single release benchmark series.
Final GPU timing was not sampled. The early no3d experiment is evidence for that CPU bottleneck, not a GPU estimate for the final scene.
Production animation sleep is narrower than the diagnostic full-animation-disable experiment; the latter is not a shippable performance result.
The maximum-population performance issue remains unresolved.
